-- SOGO JOYCE (shopId=210003) 的 UP920A-VC (productId=30003) 庫存
SELECT si.quantity, p.name as productName, p.sku
FROM shopInventory si
JOIN products p ON si.productId = p.id
WHERE si.shopId = 210003 AND p.sku = 'UP920A-VC';
